terms.name: Orientation frame
terms.definition: Site north vector and latitude_deg. Cardinals on openings come from host-edge outward normals vs north. Equator-ward is -north when latitude_deg > 0.

terms.name: Floor elevation
terms.definition: Metres above site grade for a space or storey (IFC Elevation / Zone.floor_elevation_m). Distinct from height_m (clear ceiling height).

terms.name: Outdoor
terms.definition: Space tagged outdoor: open-air zone under the building center. Main outdoor for 105 excludes balcony.

terms.name: Occupied
terms.definition: Space tagged occupied: regularly inhabited indoor room used by orientation and depth checks.

terms.name: Balcony
terms.definition: Outdoor edge tagged balcony that also sits at floor_elevation_m >= min_elevation_m (default 2.4). Ground patios are not balconies.

terms.name: Daytime
terms.definition: Occupied space used mainly by day; 128 Indoor Sunlight compares its centroid to other occupied rooms.

terms.name: Transition
terms.definition: Outdoor or semi-outdoor zone on the path from street to main door (112 Entrance Transition).
